shortDescription: Create or delete an AWS CloudFormation stack

options.name: access_key
options.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID) or C(AWS_ACCESS_KEY) environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The I(aws_access_key) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive. The I(aws_access_key_id) alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

options.name: aws_ca_bundle
options.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The C(AWS_CA_BUNDLE) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: aws_config
options.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation U(https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config).

options.name: backoff_delay
options.description: Number of seconds to wait for the next retry.

options.name: backoff_max_delay
options.description: Maximum amount of time to wait between retries.

options.name: backoff_retries
options.description: Number of times to retry operation. AWS API throttling mechanism fails CloudFormation module so we have to retry a couple of times.

options.name: capabilities
options.description: Specify capabilities that stack template contains. Valid values are V(CAPABILITY_IAM), V(CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM) and V(CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND).

options.name: changeset_name
options.description: Name given to the changeset when creating a changeset. Only used when O(create_changeset=true). By default a name prefixed with Ansible-STACKNAME is generated based on input parameters. See the AWS Change Sets docs for more information U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-changesets.html)

options.name: create_changeset
options.description: If stack already exists create a changeset instead of directly applying changes.  See the AWS Change Sets docs U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-changesets.html). B(WARNING:) if the stack does not exist, it will be created without changeset. If O(state=absent), the stack will be deleted immediately with no changeset.

options.name: create_timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in minutes) that can pass before the stack status becomes V(CREATE_FAILED).

options.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
options.description: Use a C(botocore.endpoint) logger to parse the unique (rather than total) C("resource:action") API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the C(aws_resource_action) callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The C(ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: disable_rollback
options.description: If a stacks fails to form, rollback will remove the stack.

options.name: endpoint_url
options.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints.  While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The  C(AWS_URL) environment variable may also be used.

options.name: events_limit
options.description: Maximum number of CloudFormation events to fetch from a stack when creating or updating it.

options.name: notification_arns
options.description: A comma separated list of Simple Notification Service (SNS) topic ARNs to publish stack related events.

options.name: on_create_failure
options.description: Action to take upon failure of stack creation. Incompatible with the O(disable_rollback) option.

options.name: profile
options.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html). The C(AWS_PROFILE) environment variable may also be used. The I(profile) option is mutually exclusive with the I(aws_access_key), I(aws_secret_key) and I(session_token) options.

options.name: region
options.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, I(region) is ignored. The C(AWS_REGION) environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information U(http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region).

options.name: role_arn
options.description: The role that AWS CloudFormation assumes to create the stack. See the AWS CloudFormation Service Role docs U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-iam-servicerole.html)

options.name: secret_key
options.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) or C(AWS_SECRET_KEY) environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The I(secret_key) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive. The I(aws_secret_access_key) alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

options.name: session_token
options.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys). The C(AWS_SESSION_TOKEN) environment variable may also be used. The I(session_token) and I(profile) options are mutually exclusive.

options.name: stack_name
options.description: Name of the CloudFormation stack.

options.name: stack_policy
options.description: The path of the file containing the CloudFormation stack policy. A policy cannot be removed once placed, but it can be modified. for instance, allow all updates U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/protect-stack-resources.html#d0e9051)

options.name: stack_policy_body
options.description: The CloudFormation stack policy in JSON. A policy cannot be removed once placed, but it can be modified. for instance, allow all updates U(https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/protect-stack-resources.html#d0e9051)

options.name: stack_policy_on_update_body
options.description: The body of the cloudformation stack policy only applied during this update.

options.name: state
options.description: If O(state=present), stack will be created. If O(state=present) and if stack exists and template has changed, it will be updated. If O(state=absent), stack will be removed.

options.name: tags
options.description: Dictionary of tags to associate with stack and its resources during stack creation. Can be updated later, updating tags removes previous entries.

options.name: template
options.description: The local path of the CloudFormation template. This must be the full path to the file, relative to the working directory. If using roles this may look like V(roles/cloudformation/files/cloudformation-example.json). If O(state=present) and the stack does not exist yet, either O(template), O(template_body) or O(template_url) must be specified (but only one of them). If O(state=present), the stack does exist, and neither O(template), O(template_body) nor O(template_url) are specified, the previous

options.name: template_body
options.description: Template body. Use this to pass in the actual body of the CloudFormation template. If O(state=present) and the stack does not exist yet, either O(template), O(template_body) or O(template_url) must be specified (but only one of them). If O(state=present), the stack does exist, and neither O(template), O(template_body) nor O(template_url) are specified, the previous template will be reused.

options.name: template_parameters
options.description: A list of hashes of all the template variables for the stack. The value can be a string or a dict. Dict can be used to set additional template parameter attributes like UsePreviousValue (see example).

options.name: template_url
options.description: Location of file containing the template body. The URL must point to a template (max size 307,200 bytes) located in an S3 bucket in the same region as the stack. If O(state=present) and the stack does not exist yet, either O(template), O(template_body) or O(template_url) must be specified (but only one of them). If O(state=present), the stack does exist, and neither O(template), O(template_body) nor O(template_url) are specified, the previous template will be reused.

options.name: termination_protection
options.description: Enable or disable termination protection on the stack.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: When set to C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting I(validate_certs=false) is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting I(aws_ca_bundle) instead.
